summary.semantic_revalidation_note: The counts above still describe the registered 84-gap baseline. The later semantic audit below refines many entries as anchor-only, skeletal, partial-transfer, or stale-contradictory failures rather than total absence, and it records cross-cutting canon that the earlier bundle was dropping.

deep_audit_revalidation.method: multi-agent semantic canon-transfer audit against ledger chunks and live Plans surfaces

registered_gap_refinements.theme: runtime identity, routing, permissions, and auth anchors
registered_gap_refinements.refined_assessment: Substantial runtime/account content survives, but the exact owner anchors, blocked-episode fields, closed enums, and retirement of stale aliases are still missing.
key_new_findings: `execution_unit_context` still lacks its own owner anchor even though nearby runtime packet prose survives.
`route_target` content is partly present, but closed `target_kind` still conflicts with surviving `detached_window` residue.
`Executor_Protocol.md` and subagent docs still preserve stale `TierContext`, `tier_id`, `work_package_id`, and `feature_seam_id` families.
Permission scope/snapshot prose exists, but `blocked_sequence`, `approval_scope_key`, and exact execution-entity dimensions still need the owner contract.
GitHub account keying is closer than the prior bundle said; the remaining failure is mostly missing heading plus exact canonical key fields.

registered_gap_refinements.theme: storage, runtime-artifact persistence, and receipt bridge canon
registered_gap_refinements.refined_assessment: Many storage and artifact concepts landed partially, but the exact key families, lifecycle semantics, bridge precedence, and stale-key retirements still did not.
key_new_findings: The highest-signal still-missing owner item is `orchestrator.project_state.{project_id}` and its field shape.
`historical`, `archived`, and `removed` still lack their exact distinct semantics even though lifecycle vocabulary appears nearby.
Receipt fields largely landed, but exact precedence/correctness constraints for `attempt_id`, `usage_event_ref`, `provider_attempt_ref`, and workflow/runtime refs are still absent.
Old artifact-index and `task_id` residue still survives in multiple docs and remains implementation-dangerous.
Projector/export/degrade behavior still lacks the exact projection freshness/health bridge.

registered_gap_refinements.refined_assessment: The artifact family is present by name, but the owner contracts still do not carry the exact planning/runtime lineage or launch handoff shape.
key_new_findings: `validation_pass_report` still lacks exact required fields including `workflow_run_id`, `pass_verdict`, `phase_plan_ref`, `requirements_quality_report_ref`, and `run_id`.
Chain-wizard downstream handoff still lacks the full bridge from validation lineage into launch receipt/promoted package references.

registered_gap_refinements.refined_assessment: `Glossary.md` is no longer empty; it now has token lists and schema fragments. The live failure is that the required anchors, instantiated entries, and cross-linking help architecture still did not transfer.
key_new_findings: The missing `### Orchestrator rewrite terms` heading still breaks live cross-references from `Orchestrator_Page.md`.
Runtime/routing terms exist only as partial bullets rather than owned help entries carrying exact behavior and data shapes.
The help-entry schema fragments are not instantiated for any required concept family.

registered_gap_refinements.theme: open-subject, route-target, and command normalization canon
registered_gap_refinements.refined_assessment: These sections are closer than the earlier bundle said, but the exact command-envelope contract, search/open routing shape, and recovery-command anchor remain incomplete.
key_new_findings: `FinalGUISpec.md §7.3` still does not carry the exact `route_target` payload shape, selector exclusivity, subject families, and shell destinations, so routing remains materially blocked.
`OpenSubject` is referenced but still lacks the exact owner anchor and subject-id family closure.
`UI_Command_Catalog.md` carries normalization ideas and command tables, but not the exact `command_kind`/normalization contract or per-command policy fields.
Search remains materially blocked because prose points at the shared route payload while a concrete command still uses `result_id`.
Recovery-command canon exists headinglessly after `## References`; the anchor is still missing even though content exists.

registered_gap_refinements.theme: orchestrator and final gui structural ownership
registered_gap_refinements.refined_assessment: Several of these entries were overstated as empty. The real failure is that meaningful prose exists without the required section anchors, closed families, or historical-run extensions.
key_new_findings: `FIDELITY-056`, `FIDELITY-062`, and `FIDELITY-070` are mostly anchor-only or section-allocation failures rather than total absences.

`Orchestrator_Page.md` already carries meaningful concern-state semantics, but `## 12. Concern and notification model` is still missing as a discoverable section and still lacks the closed `owner_kind`/alert-level sets.
`History` and `Current vs historical` sections still do not exist, so shared historical vocabulary and worktree lifecycle distinctions remain hard to find and incomplete.
Historical run identity is partly present, but the route extension and exact field set are still missing.

registered_gap_refinements.theme: chat, hitl, tools, and wiring blocked-episode identity
registered_gap_refinements.refined_assessment: Blocked-state and approval content exists in pieces, but the shared blocked-episode identity and escalation fields still do not line up across consumer docs.
key_new_findings: `assistant-chat-design.md` still treats blocked lifecycle and persistence sections skeletally around `blocked_sequence`, `approval_scope_key`, `report_ref`, and `startup_recovered`.
`Tools.md` still preserves the stale ask-flow payload `{ tool_name, invocation_summary, options }` rather than the newer blocked-episode contract.
`human-in-the-loop.md` approval ladders still miss `escalation_level`, `blocked_sequence`, and `action_available`.

registered_gap_refinements.theme: usage, interview, and subagent runtime attribution
registered_gap_refinements.refined_assessment: These docs carry meaningful requested/effective runtime identity and usage schema fragments, but they still leave major account/projection/bridge canon to be invented.
key_new_findings: `orchestrator-subagent-integration.md` still carries pervasive `TierContext`/`tier_id` residue despite a real unheaded `execution_unit_context` block.
`interview-subagent-integration.md` already carries most persona-side requested/effective fields; the remaining gap is the account-side contract and shared packet reuse.
`usage-feature.md` already includes `node_id` and `attempt_id` in one schema, but still misses `lane_id`, `package_id`, `execution_role`, `operational_identity`, and bridge semantics.
Projection health/freshness, blocked-owner vocabulary, escalation ladder, account history families, and unified attribution packet are still absent or local-only.

registered_gap_refinements.theme: stale-survivor cleanup remains a material blocker
registered_gap_refinements.refined_assessment: Several failures remain dangerous because the stale contract is still actively visible, not merely omitted.
key_new_findings: Unauthorized or retired values still survive in route, execution, storage, and approval docs.
